The '''inducer''' was an interrogation and [[Torture/Legends|torture]] device used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. It was a more advanced version of the [[scan grid]] that had been used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to torture the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Zuud]] to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] [[Jorin Sol]]. It triggered the subject's pain receptors at random intervals, which would cause them to experience the sensation of being frozen and burned at the same time.<ref name="krytos">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

During [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn's]] imprisonment on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', he was subjected to the tortures of the Inducer by [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]].<ref name="krytos" />
